source: 651 An Unfulfilled Conspiracy
target: 651 Coniuratio Inexpleta

source: In the beige, four-story patrol team building, Camus had managed to break free from the poker card’s influence.
target: In aedificio quadristorio coloris beige, in quo turma vigilium congregata erat, Camus se a potentia chartae pokerae liberare potuit.

source: He discovered Sow sprawled in a pool of blood, brutally torn apart by two zombie-like undead creatures.
target: Invenit Sow in stagno sanguinis iacere, crudeler ab duabus creaturis non mortuis—similibus zombis—dilaceratum.

source: In neighboring rooms, another patrol team member, under Twanaku’s control, put up a stubborn resistance.
target: In cellis vicinis, alius membrum turmae vigilium, sub potestate Twanaku, pertinaciter resistit.

source: His comrades had already fallen victim to the relentless assault.
target: Comites eius iam impetu implacabili victi erant.

source: Camus, catching his breath, hadn’t anticipated stumbling upon an assassination plot within the patrol team, putting his own life at risk.
target: Camus, spiritum recipiens, non exspectavit insidiam inter turma vigilium invenire, quae vitam suam in discrimen adducebat.

source: His gaze fixed on Deputy Captain Reaza, a middle-aged man in a sleek black suit controlling the undead creatures.
target: Oculus eius in vice capitaneum Reaza fixus erat, virum medii aetatis, veste nigra nitida indutum, qui creaturas non mortuas imperabat.

source: Confused, Camus inquired, “How did Sow end up joining the Rose School of Thought?”
target: Confusus, Camus quaesivit: “Quomodo Sow ad Schola Rosi Cogitationis accessit?”

source: “And why are so many members under their control?”
target: “Et cur tot membra sub eorum potestate sunt?”

source: Despite Camus resisting the poker card’s influence, Jenna’s earlier shout lingered in his mind.
target: Quamquam Camus influxui chartae pokerae repugnabat, strepitus Jennae priore in mente eius mansit.

source: Reaza, surveying the scene of blood and undead, responded after a moment of contemplation, “It’s likely Twanaku’s doing.”
target: Reaza, totam scenam sanguinis et creaturarum non mortuarum intuens, post momentum considerationis respondit: “Fortasse id est opera Twanaku.”

source: Twanaku… Camus recalled the questions raised by Louis Berry.
target: Twanaku… Camus meminit quaestionum quas a Ludovico Berry positas fuerant.

source: Was Twanaku truly responsible for the serial murders four years ago?
target: Numquid Twanaku vere erat culpabilis homicidiorum seriarum ante quattuor annos?

source: Could he be a Devil in disguise?
target: Num poterat esse diabolus sub specie?

source: Frowning, Camus grumbled, “Keeping a Zombie on the team was already a significant risk.
target: Frons contrita, Camus murmurat: “Tenere zombiem in turma iam periculum grave fuit—

source: Just because he can show restraint doesn’t clear him from suspicion of being a Rose School of Thought member.
target: non solum quod se continere possit, sed suspicio eius de membership Scholae Rosi Cogitationis non tollitur.

source: He might indulge at specific times.”
target: Forsitan in quibusdam temporibus indulget.”

source: Reaza, with a stern demeanor, spoke in a deep voice, “We’d confirmed he defected from the Rose School of Thought.
target: Reaza, vultu severo, voce profunda dixit: “Comprobavimus eum ab Schola Rosi Cogitationis defectionem fuisse.

source: He believes in The Fool.”
target: Credebat in Fatuum.

source: “The Fool, the temperance faction?” Camus asked in surprise, not expecting such a revelation.
target: “Fatuus, factio temperantiae?” inquit Camus, admirans, talem revelationem non exspectans.

source: In the dream’s interrogation room, housed within the ancient and crumbling palace of the Nation of the Evernight, Hisoka couldn’t contain his amusement at Lumian’s question.
target: In cubiculo interrogationis somnii, quod in antiquo et corruento palatio Nationis Noctis Aeternae situm erat, Hisoka iocum suum de quaestione Lumiani continere non potuit.

source: “If you had sought the Tarot Club’s assistance, I could have killed you!”
target: “Si auxilium Circuli Taroti petivisses, te occidere potuissem!”

source: Hisoka’s laughter reverberated, and his black shadow danced on the wall, morphing into curved goat horns and colossal bat wings.
target: Risus Hisoka resonavit, et umbra eius nigra in pariete saltavit, mutans se in cornua caprina incurva et alas vespertilionum ingentium.

source: Lumian caught a whiff of a conspiracy and asked in confusion and curiosity, “Why do you think so?”
target: Lumian odorem coniurationis apprehendit et, confusus atque curiosus, rogavit: “Cur ita putas?”

source: Hisoka rose, a murderous glint materializing in his eyes.
target: Hisoka surrexit, in oculis fulgore homicidali luce manifestato.

source: “If you involve the Tarot Club, they’ll undoubtedly seek my aid in your investigation.”
target: “Si Circulum Taroti involueris, sine dubio auxilium meum in inquisitione tua petent.”

source: At this point, Hisoka’s lips curled into an unusually flamboyant smile.
target: Hoc tempore, Hisoka labia in risum insolite effulgentem convoluta sunt.

source: No longer conscious in the dream, he revealed his innermost self.
target: Iam non somnio conscius, se intimum revelavit.

source: Lumian raised an eyebrow, asking, “Are you a Minor Arcana card holder?”
target: Lumian supercilium attollens rogavit: “Esne possessor cartae Arcanae Minoris?”

source: Hisoka shook his head, replying with a radiant smile, “I’m a member of the temperance faction, a devotee of Mr. Fool.”
target: Hisoka caput movit, et respondit radianti risu: “Factionis temperantiae membrum sum, cultor Domini Fatuus.”

source: The Devil burst into laughter, bowing and exclaiming, “Praise The Fool!”
target: Diabolus in risum eruptus est, se flectens atque exclamans: “Lauda Fatuum!”

source: Lumian, finding it absurd and amusing, instinctively analyzed the situation.
target: Lumian, id absurdum atque iocosum existimans, rem instinctive examinavit.

source: Hisoka is actually a member of the Rose School of Thought’s temperance faction?
target: Numquid Hisoka revera est membrum factionis temperantiae Scholae Rosi Cogitationis?

source: A flamboyant and malicious Devil is actually a member of the temperance faction?
target: Diabolus ostentator et malignus revera est membrum factionis temperantiae?

source: Logically speaking, this was clearly impossible!
target: Ratione loquendo, hoc plane impossibile erat!

source: Yet, in this dream crafted by Hela, unless Hisoka possessed unique abilities to deceive, lying was unlikely.
target: Attamen, in hoc somnio ab Hela confecto, nisi Hisoka facultates unicas ad fallendum haberet, mendacium vix fieri poterat.

source: The only plausible explanation: he had infiltrated the temperance faction through deception and deceit!
target: Unica ratio plausibilis: se per dolum et fraude in factionem temperantiae infiltraverat!

source: On the surface, Hisoka seemed to be a Beyonder of the Prisoner pathway, displaying a level of restraint.
target: Superficialiter, Hisoka videbatur Beyonder semitae Captivi, aliquam moderationis mensuram ostendens.

source: As a non-core member of the temperance faction, he might have gone unnoticed with his issues.
target: Sicut membrum non nuclei factionis temperantiae, fortasse suis rebus parum notus fuit.

source: Right, is this why the Matani patrol team allowed a Prisoner pathway Beyonder to join?
target: Recte, num hoc est causa cur turma Matani vigilium sineret Beyonder semitae Captivi se adiungere?

source: This was more than four years ago.
target: Hoc erat abhinc plus quam quattuor annos.

source: Back then, Hisoka was merely a Sequence 8 Lunatic of the Prisoner pathway, not yet a Mid-Sequence Beyonder.
target: Tunc, Hisoka erat solum Lunaticus Sequenciae VIII semitae Captivi, nondum Beyonder medii Sequenciae.

source: As a peripheral member of the temperance faction, he likely operated without much scrutiny.
target: Ut membrum perifericum factionis temperantiae, probabiliter sine magna vigilantia operabatur.

source: Moreover, he probably joined the temperance faction before this, when he was weaker and less noticeable.
target: Praeterea, fortasse ante hoc in factionem temperantiae se iunxit, cum infirmior atque minus conspicuus esset.

source: Later, he faked receiving resources from the temperance faction and the Rose School of Thought’s attack to advance.
target: Postea, se simulavit subsidia accipere ex factione temperantiae et impetus Scholae Rosi Cogitationis ad proficisciendum.

source: In reality, did he rely on the Mother Tree of Desire’s boons?
target: Revera, num in dona Mater Arboris Desiderii innixus esset?

source: Where did those resources go?
target: Quo illa subsidia pervenerunt?

source: Were they secretly sold or crafted into a mystical item?
target: An furtim venditae aut in rem mysticam confectae erant?

source: That poker card?
target: Illam chartam pokerae?

source: Why did he infiltrate the temperance faction and worship Mr. Fool?
target: Cur se in factionem temperantiae infiltravit et Dominum Fatuum veneratus est?

source: His main goal clearly isn’t resources…
target: Praecipuum propositum eius manifeste non subsidia est…

source: Faith in Mr. Fool…
target: Fides in Dominum Fatuum…

source: With this in mind, Lumian suddenly had a guess.
target: Hoc mente tractato, Lumian subito coniecturam habuit.

source: Hisoka’s true aim was to infiltrate the Church of The Fool through a certain pathway and have faith in Mr. Fool!
target: Propositum verum Hisokae erat Ecclesiam Fatuum per certam viam infiltrare et fidem in Dominum Fatuum habere!

source: This revelation came from Celestial Worthy!
target: Haec revelatio venit a Caelesti Dignitate!

source: Hisoka genuinely believes in the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings.
target: Hisoka sincere credit in Caelestem Dignitatem Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus.

source: However, that Celestial Worthy is resisting Mr. Fool.
target: Attamen, illa Caelestis Dignitas contra Dominum Fatuum opponit.

source: He can clearly influence the Seer, Apprentice, and Marauder pathways…
target: Clare potest influere in semitis Vatis, Discipuli, et Maraudantium…

source: Hisoka used a specific technique during prayer.
target: Hisoka technicam specificam in oratione usus est.

source: On the surface, he seemed to be praying to Mr. Fool, but in reality, did he receive a message from that Celestial Worthy?
target: Superficialiter, videbatur se Domino Fatuum orare, sed re vera, num nuntium ab illa Caelesti Dignitate accepisset?

source: This way, he wouldn’t face the risk of a false premise…
target: Sic non periculum falsae praemissionis subiret.

source: That’s very likely… Madam Magician mentioned that if I don’t follow the procedures when praying to Mr. Fool, the response might not be from him, but from the Celestial Worthy…
target: Hoc plane verisimile est… Domina Magica dixit, si praecepta non sequer, cum ad Dominum Fatuum orandum, responsum non ab eo, sed ab illa Caelesti Dignitate fieri posse.

source: Why did Celestial Worthy make Hisoka do this?
target: Cur Caelestis Dignitas Hisoka ita facere iussit?

source: Marauder… Steal… Could It be that He intends to gradually steal Mr. Fool’s identity and faith through this method?
target: Marauder… Furare… Num ita intendit ut paulatim identitatem et fidem Domini Fatuum per hanc viam subtrahat?

source: When many believers genuinely believe in Mr. Fool, but they equate him as the Celestial Worthy, the Celestial Worthy becomes The Fool?
target: Cum multi credentes vere in Domino Fatuum existimant eum ut Caelesti Dignitati, illa Caelestis Dignitas fit Fatuus?

source: Hiss, the more I think about it, the more terrifying it becomes…
target: Sibilus, quo magis cogito, eo terribilius fit…

source: Hisoka can’t do it alone.
target: Hisoka id solus facere non potest.

source: There must be many others who share similar beliefs…
target: Oportet esse multi alii qui similia credant…

source: Impressive. If the Celestial Worthy usually gathers followers, the Tarot Club would wipe them out at the slightest hint.
target: Impressionans. Si Caelestis Dignitas plerumque sectatores congregat, Circulus Taroti eos minimo signo delebit.

source: Yet, if their followers outwardly professed faith in Mr. Fool, not only would they escape destruction, but they’d also gain protection…
target: Attamen, si fautores eorum fidem in Domino Fatuum patefecerint, non solum exitum effugirent, sed etiam protectionem acquirerent…

source: How devious…
target: Quam dolosus…

source: Lumian swiftly deduced the situation, sensing the ominous pressure from the hidden Celestial Worthy.
target: Lumian celeriter rem deduxit, pressuram ominosam a celata Caelestis Dignitate sentiens.

source: Once marked by Him, failure could creep in unnoticed and strike him down unexpectedly!
target: Signatum ab eo receptum, defectus poterat latentissime insidiari et eum subitam deicere!

source: Considering this, Lumian recalled Port Pylos and grasped Hisoka’s confidence.
target: Ratione hoc conspecta, Lumian Portum Pylos recordatus est et fiduciam Hisokae comprehendit.

source: He also comprehended why Hisoka had opted to remain and wait patiently.
target: Item intellexit cur Hisoka manere et patienter exspectare optasset.

source: Freshly arrived in the Southern Continent and stepping into Port Pylos for the first time, Lumian lacked resources, companions, and even knowledge of Dutanese.
target: Recens adveniens in Continente Meridionali atque ad Portum Pylos primum ingrediens, Lumian caruit subsidiis, sodalibus, necnon cognitione Dutanicae.

source: There was a high likelihood that he’d seek aid from the Tarot Club standing behind him.
target: Magna probabilitas erat ut auxilium a Circulo Taroti, qui eum subsequebatur, quaereret.

source: The Major Arcana card holders of the Tarot Club wouldn’t personally intervene without a clear target due to the uncertain timeframe.
target: Possessores Cartarum Majorum Arcanorum Circuli Taroti non personaliter intercederent sine clarissimo obiecto propter incertum tempus.

source: They would likely dispatch a Minor Arcana card holder familiar with the Southern Continent or a faction member to assist.
target: Probabiliter mitterent possessorem Cartae Minorum Arcanorum, notum in Continenti Meridionali, aut membrum factionis ad auxilium.

source: Under these circumstances, who better to meet the requirements than Twanaku Tupián, a Church of The Fool’s temperance faction member from Matani, well-versed in the local situation, holding the appropriate official status, and reaching Sequence 6.
target: His condicione, quis melius requisita expleat quam Twanaku Tupián, membrum factionis temperantiae Ecclesiae Fatuum ex Matani, in rebus localibus peritus, officiali dignitate praeditus, et Sequenciam VI adeptus?

source: In that scenario, Lumian and Hisoka would investigate Hisoka.
target: In illa re, Lumian et Hisoka Hisoka investigabunt.

source: The other party would gradually grasp the situation, assess potential traps and their effectiveness.
target: Pars altera paulatim rem comprehenderet, insidias potentiales et earum efficacitatem examinans.

source: Hisoka could then seize the opportunity for a surprise attack, assault the mind, and trigger desires!
target: Hisoka ergo occasionem capere poterat ad impetum subitum, mentem oppugnare, et desideria incitare!

source: Contemplating this, Lumian acknowledged that if he failed to detect Hisoka’s malice during the investigation, the chances of succumbing to Hisoka’s hands were 100%.
target: Cum hoc cogitans, Lumian agnovit quod, si Hisokae malitiam durante inquisitione detegere non potuisset, casus cessionis sub manibus eius essent centum per centum.

source: He’d be a spectator as the Devil faced off against Termiboros in the form of a soul fragment.
target: Ille spectatorem esset, dum Diabolus contra Termiboros in forma fracti animae certaret.

source: Hisoka, informed by Loki, should have made preparations to deal with the dangerous creature within the seal.
target: Hisoka, a Loki informatus, praeparationes facere debuisset ut cum creatura periculosa intra sigillum ageret.

source: Perhaps relying on the Nois family’s Demon or his status as a Blessed of the Mother Tree of Desire.
target: Fortasse innixus Daemone familiae Nois aut statuto ut Benedictus Mater Arboris Desiderii.

source: Thankfully, Madam Magician kept reminding me that a Hunter can’t rely on high-ranking individuals behind an organization for everything.
target: Gratias tamen Domina Magica me monere continuabat: venatorem in omnibus rebus non posse in summis hominibus intra organizationem innixi.

source: I need to hone my skills, familiarize myself with conspiracies and battles.
target: Artem meam perficiendam, coniurationes et pugnas cognoscere mihi necessarium est.

source: Otherwise, I might have sought guidance from the Tarot Club as soon as I arrived in Port Pyro…
target: Alio modo, consilium a Circulo Taroti quaesivissem, simul ac in Portum Pyro pervenissem…

source: That would have been dangerous…
target: Id periculosum fuisset…

source: Grande Soeur and Emperor Roselle both mentioned that the most dangerous places are often the safest.
target: Grande Soeur et Imperator Roselle ambo dixerunt loca maxime periculosa saepe esse tuta.

source: Now, I must add that those who seem the safest and most reliable might pose the greatest risk…
target: Nunc addere debeo quod qui tuta et fide digna videntur, maximum periculum afferre possint…

source: It’s not that they’re no longer trustworthy, but the enemy will exploit this sense of security.
target: Non est quod iam non sint fideles, sed hostis hunc sensum securitatis abutere vult.

source: Yes, Madam Magician has also emphasized that if anything seems awry with her orders and suggestions, I should ignore them.
target: Ita, Domina Magica etiam extulit, si quid in mandatis et suggestionibus eius anomale videatur, id neglegendum esse.

source: Quickly contacting the other Major Arcana card holders to confirm the situation is crucial.
target: Celeriter alios possessores Cartarum Majorum Arcanorum contingere ad rem confirmandam necessarium est.

source: Lumian gazed at the flamboyant Hisoka and smiled.
target: Lumian Hisoka effusi speciem intuebatur et subridet.

source: “If I hadn’t received help from a special trace expert, if Hidden Blade hadn’t been more familiar with your persona, and if I hadn’t had a Psychiatrist to profile you, and ultimately failed to find any clues or direction, I would have sought the Tarot Club’s help and looked for a guide familiar with the local situation.”
target: “Nisi auxilium a perito vestigandi speciali acceperer, nisi Hidden Blade de tua persona magis notus esset, et nisi Psychiatrum ad te descriptum haberem, atque denique nullas indagationis vestigia invenire potuissem, auxilium Circuli Taroti quaesivissem et ducem in rebus localibus peritum rogavero.”

source: Hisoka fell into silence.
target: Hisoka silentio cecidit.

source: After a few moments, he spoke up, “I get everything else, but why the sudden need for a special trace expert?”
target: Post paucos momenta, locutus est: “Ceterum omnia intellego, sed cur subito opus est perito vestigandi speciali?”

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian risit.

source: “Because it’s a gift from a true god.”
target: “Quia donum est a deo vero.”

source: The more time Lumian spent with Ludwig, the more he felt that letting such a dangerous individual escape the Church’s control wasn’t a decision a high-ranking member of the Church of Knowledge would make.
target: Quo diutius Lumian cum Ludovigo conversatus est, eo magis sensit quod relinquere tam periculosum individuum a potestate Ecclesiae non esset consilium membri altioris Ecclesiae Cognitionis.

source: There had to be a revelation from the God of Knowledge and Wisdom.
target: Oportuit revelationem a Deo Cognitionis et Sapientiae esse.

source: Certainly, Lumian couldn’t be sure.
target: Certe, Lumian non potuit certo scire.

source: As far as he knew, the Knowledge pathway, also known as the Reader pathway, excelled in prophecies at high Sequence.
target: Quoad sciebat, via Cognitionis, etiam via Legentis appellata, in prophetia ad altissimam Sequenciam excellere solebat.

source: Hisoka fell into silence for a moment before unleashing a roar, much like a wild wolf howling beneath the moon.
target: Hisoka momento silentium cepit, deinde fremitum edidit, instar lupi feri sub luna ululantis.

source: Lumian reviewed the entire incident, realizing that this revenge was a clash of conspiracies.
target: Lumian totum casum recognovit, intellegens hanc ultio esse congressionem coniurationum.

source: Unfortunately, Hisoka didn’t grasp his personality and style well enough, nor did he comprehend his companions.
target: Infeliciter, Hisoka eius indolem ac modum satis bene non apprehendit, nec comites suos intellexit.

source: He could only rely on the sea prayer ritual and Loki’s first death as a guide.
target: Solum in ritu preces maritimae et in prima morte Loki ut ducem confidere poterat.

source: Consequently, there was a deviation, shattering his expectations despite a high likelihood of success.
target: Consequenter, factum est aberratio, dissipans eius exspectationes, quamquam magna probabilitas successus erat.

source: Phew… Lumian exhaled and inquired, “Who were the ones causing havoc on the patrol team’s side?”
target: Phew… Lumian suspiravit et rogavit: “Qui erant illi qui in parte turmae vigilium cladem intulerunt?”
